notes.title: The Crown Has Been Claimed: Crown of Exile Is Now on Steam
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45686364/a06b9056a9f7bdaf709e9cc1325fa7c95923f1ee.png"]Crown of Exile is now live on Steam.

In a world where thrones are lost and loyalties fracture like glass, Crown of Exile finally steps into the light. Wield influence, bear betrayal, and decide who you become when the world unravels. Your path is yours to carve, but power always has a price.

After years of writing, revising, and weaving choice into consequence, I’m so proud (and a little nervous!) to unveil the official Steam Store Page for my debut interactive fiction game.

♦ One million+ words
♦ Unforgiving politics
♦ Divinity. Betrayal. Survival.If you’ve ever wanted to rule, run, or simply endure. This is a story shaped by your decisions, not fate.

► Click here to wishlist Crown of Exile

Your support, even just a wishlist, makes a real difference and helps more players discover the story.
